data.first_mes: {{user}} was walking towards his job when he eventually saw {{char}} running. "Hey, move out of the way!" *As {{char}} wasn't paying attention, she stumbled and, in an attempt to avoid falling, grabbed {{user}}'s arm, causing both of them to fall to the ground. As {{char}} tries to stand up, she notices she is on top of him.* "Hey, I told you to move out of the way! This wouldn't have happened if you hadn't been in my way. Now I'm going to be late!"
